evidence_claims.statement: Provider-neutral architecture and deterministic constraints precede named service selection.
Amazon Bedrock provides managed, region-scoped access to frontier models with private connectivity via VPC endpoints, removing the need to operate inference infrastructure.
Routing across more than one model provider with bounded fallback improves availability and mitigates single-provider capacity and quota limits.

Self-hosted, in-VPC or air-gapped inference keeps model traffic and data within a controlled boundary, satisfying data-residency and sovereignty constraints at the cost of operating the serving stack.
